info.text:
At Lamar, 1 in 30 billboards earns a third of billboard revenue.
Lamar Advertising ran about 159,300 billboards at the end of 2025; about 5,500 digital ones earned about 33% of billboard revenue (2025 10-K).
Our math: about $120,800 a year per digital board versus about $8,770 per printed one in 2025.
The pole is built once, often on leased land; Lamar is a REIT, and the 1965 Highway Beautification Act limits billboards along major highways.
US out-of-home ad revenue hit a record $9.46 billion in 2025 (OAAA).
Sources: Lamar Advertising 2025 Form 10-K and results release, OAAA, FHWA.
News and education, not financial advice.
